name: IconQA
description: A large-scale benchmark for abstract diagram understanding and visual language reasoning, consisting of 107,439 questions across three sub-tasks: multi-image-choice, multi-text-choice, and filling-in-the-blank. It requires perception and diverse cognitive reasoning skills such as geometric, commonsense, and arithmetic reasoning.
reputation: A widely used vision-language reasoning benchmark for abstract diagram understanding, often cited in work on multimodal QA and visual reasoning.
notes: Includes an additional icon dataset Icon645 with 645,687 colored icons on 377 classes to facilitate semantic representation learning.
